youtube_title: Flooded Underpass: Drive Through or Turn Back? Brave vs Normal #3 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL - WHO'S RIGHT? #3. Heavy rain and the underpass is full of water. Brave drives in. Normal stops, reverses and takes another route on higher ground. Who's right?
Answer: Normal. According to the US National Weather Service, just 1 foot (about 30 cm) of moving water can sweep away most cars, and you can't tell how deep the water in an underpass is or whether the road under it is intact. Never drive into floodwater: Turn Around, Don't Drown. If your car gets stuck in rising water, get out right away and move to higher ground.
Source: US National Weather Service (Turn Around Don't Drown); NDMA flood safety tips.
